besluite.rede: In a run of added reasons 'ook vandag nodig en kan nie wag nie' reads clearly; the proposal also swaps the concrete 'vandag' for 'dadelik' and adds 'boonop', a lateral move that shifts a word for a Grade 6 reader.

besluite.fout: 'Geen se oor' copies English 'no say over'; Afrikaans uses the standard noun 'inspraak in'.
besluite.rede: Same meaning (no voice in the work or the pay), standard idiom, same length.

besluite.fout: 'ook' twice in one sentence ('is ook nie net ... maar ook') is clumsy.
besluite.rede: 'verder' keeps the link to the previous sentence and removes the repetition without changing what the sentence says.
